title: How are influencers affecting politics?
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Why can influencers sometimes persuade people politically more effectively than traditional politicians?
Should influencers have to clearly label paid political content?
Is it a problem when people receive most of their political information from personalities they follow for entertainment?
How can voters distinguish genuine opinion from coordinated political marketing online?
Would you trust a political recommendation more or less if it came from an influencer you already liked?
